text:
elaine: Heads-up — new docs policy for SDK quickstarts & sample code. TL;DR: every SDK quickstart must be runnable out of the box (container or single-command), include an SPDX license header, and ship an explicit opt-in telemetry snippet. See PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482 (summary below).

sam: Quick q — mandatory for all languages or phased?

elaine: Phased. JS + Python first (deadline Apr 15), then Go/Rust/others over the next 8 weeks. Policy doc in PR has the rollout matrix.

ben: Do we have a canonical Dockerfile / smoke-test harness to copy?

maria: Yes — added templates under docs/examples/docker-templates. Use the multi-stage pattern and set RW_EXAMPLE_MODE=1 in CI.

ben: Nice, will update the python quickstart.

oakley: Will this require CI changes for repo owners? We need to run quickstart smoke tests in the docs pipeline.

docs-ci-bot: CI job added: docs/quickstart-smoke-tests (stages: build -> run -> verify). Job flags failing examples as docs-blocking.

sam: Telemetry: does "opt-in" mean examples must NOT call home by default?

elaine: Correct — examples cannot emit any telemetry by default. Telemetry must be explicitly opt-in and documented. Include this tiny snippet as the canonical opt-in:

```bash
# opt-in telemetry (examples): users must set this to enable sample telemetry
export RW_EXAMPLE_TELEMETRY=1
```

maria: Also: samples must include an SPDX header at top of files and a note in README about the license. We added license templates in docs/legal/examples-license.md.

ben: Any deprecation for older "snippet-only" examples (the ones that assume local CLI setup)?

elaine: Yes — deprecation timeline: older snippet-only examples will be supported for 30 days after Apr 15, then auto-archived into docs/legacy-examples. Owners will get a notification from the docs bot 7 days before archive.

oakley: For Dedicated/private customers we should add a "local-runtime" variant that shows env and KMS hints. Is that in scope?

elaine: Good call — adding a checkbox to the template for a "local/private" variant. Owners can mark examples with metadata: runtime=private to include the KMS hints.

sam: Who signs off? Docs + SDK leads?

elaine: Approvals: Docs PM (me), SDK lead (ben for python/js), and Security (oakley). I created an approval workflow in the PR.

maria: Action items for owners: 1) Replace snippet-only quickstarts with containerized example or single script; 2) Add SPDX header; 3) Add opt-in telemetry snippet & README note; 4) Add smoke-test entry. Deadline for phase 1 (JS/Python): Apr 15.

ben: I'll take python quickstart.

sam: I'll do js.

elaine: Thanks. If you hit blockers reply here or ping me. Will follow up with a short docs workshop next Wed 10am to walk through the templates. :calendar: :white_check_mark:
